title: P6A Reading Comprehension Practice
title_zh: 小六閱讀理解練習（兩組）

scoring.attempt_rule: On the first wrong attempt, show the first-error hint and allow at least one retry. Record first_correct if the first submission is fully correct; record hinted_success if the item becomes fully correct only after a hint. A later wrong retry is marked incorrect after the explanatory feedback is shown.
scoring.heading_match_scheme: S1-H01 is one scored item covering Boxes A–E. All five headings must be correct for the item to score. A first-error hint names or describes the first incorrect box only and does not list the full key.
scoring.multi_select_scheme: Exact set of correct options only. A partially correct set is treated as wrong.
scoring.gap_marking: Trim leading/trailing space and ignore letter case. Do not accept extra words or a different word from the passage unless listed under accepted. British spelling is required where the forms differ (e.g. practise is not used as a gap here).
scoring.pictures: No item requires a picture to answer. Passages stay visible while the pupil answers.

stations.title: Set 1 — Leisure Centre Lifeguard
stations.title_zh: 第一組：休閒中心救生員網頁
stations.student_stem_en: H. Maya is reading a webpage about jobs in the community. Read it.
stations.student_stem_zh: H. Maya 正在閱讀一個關於社區工作的網頁。請細心閱讀。

items.direction_en: Read the webpage again. Write the correct headings in the boxes.
items.direction_zh: 再讀一次網頁。把正確的小標題寫在空格內。
items.bank_note: Introduction is already placed in the webpage and should remain there. It stays in the bank so the paper matches the source layout; online, treat it as already used.
items.match_rule: Exact heading from the bank, including &. Do not accept pupil-style rewrites such as 'skills + qualities' in the online auto-mark, but a later paper mark-scheme may treat an unambiguous handwritten equivalent as acceptable (see teacher-key.md).

hints.first_error: 先檢查第一個不正確的空格。讀該段的第一句，想想這一段是在講職責、條件、薪酬工時、入職要求，還是更多資料。小標題必須用題目提供的詞語，不要自行改寫。

hint_by_first_wrong_slot.A: 第 5 行空格後面的一段以 First, Then, Next, Finally 來說明救生員做甚麼。這是在描述工作內容。
hint_by_first_wrong_slot.B: 第 11 行空格後面是 To be a leisure centre lifeguard, you need to: 和一個清單。想想清單裏列出的是甚麼。
hint_by_first_wrong_slot.C: 第 18 行空格後面提到每月可賺多少錢，以及每天和每星期工作多久。
hint_by_first_wrong_slot.D: 第 21 行空格後面先說 The most important requirement，接着說明可以用甚麼途徑學習這份工作。
hint_by_first_wrong_slot.E: 第 27 行空格後面只有一個網站，並邀請有興趣的人去了解更多和觀看訪問。

feedback.correct: Five headings are in the right boxes. Introduction was already in place.
feedback.incorrect_after_retry: Box A (line 5) is Job descriptions; Box B (line 11) is Skills & Qualities; Box C (line 18) is Income & working hours; Box D (line 21) is Entry requirements; Box E (line 27) is More information.

items.explanation: Each heading names the job of that section: a sequence of duties; a ‘you need to’ list of skills and qualities; pay and hours; how to become a lifeguard; and a website for further information.

items.stem: Which word in the webpage means ‘right for a particular purpose’?

hints.first_error: 看第 3 行：this job could be ______ for you。哪一個詞的意思最接近 ‘right for a particular purpose’？同一行還有另一個形容詞，但意思不同。

feedback.correct: Yes. In line 3, suitable means right for a particular purpose: the job could be a good / right choice for you.
feedback.incorrect_after_retry: The answer is A, suitable (line 3). Responsible (also line 3) describes a serious job with important duties, not ‘right for a purpose’. Safe (line 2) means not in danger. Alert (line 14) means watchful.

items.explanation: Vocabulary in context with a same-line distractor (responsible, line 3) and nearby / later-line distractors (safe, line 2; alert, line 14).

items.stem: How many hours does a lifeguard work each week?

hints.first_error: 閱讀第 19–20 行：lifeguards usually work about 8 hours a day, six days a week。題目問的是 each week，需要把兩個數字合起來算，不要只抄每天的時數。

feedback.correct: Yes. 8 hours a day × six days a week = 48 hours a week.
feedback.incorrect_after_retry: The answer is B, 48 hours. Lines 19–20 say about 8 hours a day, six days a week. 8 × 6 = 48. A is only the hours in one day. C is 8 × 7, as if they worked every day of the week. D is 8 × 6 × 4, as if the question asked about four weeks.

items.explanation: Combination / calculation inference from two figures in the income and working hours section.

items.stem: What can’t you read about in this webpage?

options.text: how to become a leisure centre lifeguard
what type of people can become leisure centre lifeguards
what a lifeguard’s uniform looks like

hints.first_error: 逐項對照網頁：哪些在「工作內容」「入職要求」或「技能與特質」已經出現？找出完全沒有提及的一項。

feedback.correct: Yes. The webpage never describes a lifeguard’s uniform.
feedback.incorrect_after_retry: The answer is D. A is in the job descriptions (lines 6–10). B is in the entry requirements (lines 22–26). C is in the skills list and the opening lines (for example, a strong swimmer who can stay alert). The webpage does not mention a uniform.

items.explanation: Identify the option that is clearly absent from the webpage.

items.stem: Which of the following is NOT true?

options.text: Lifeguards check the pool before opening time.
You must go to a sports college to learn how to be a lifeguard.
You can learn about some lifeguards on the Internet.

hints.first_error: 特別留意第 23–26 行怎樣說明學習途徑。Another option 表示這只是其中一個方法，並不是唯一或必須的方法。題目問的是哪一項 is NOT true。

feedback.correct: Yes. C is not true. A college course is only another option, not a must.
feedback.incorrect_after_retry: The answer is C. Lines 23–25 say you can join a training programme at a swimming club and practise with an experienced lifeguard. A recognised lifesaving course at a sports college is another option, so you must not treat it as compulsory. A is true (lines 1–2). B is true (lines 6–7). D is true because the website in lines 28–30 has interviews with several lifeguards.

items.explanation: Negative comprehension with a ‘must’ trap: the text offers a college course as an option, not a requirement. The stem uses correct English (is NOT true).

items.direction_en: You can choose more than one answer.
items.direction_zh: 選出最合適的答案。你可以選擇多於一個答案。

options.text: must have his or her own swimming pool
must stay alert and be able to react quickly

items.marking: Exact set only. Award the mark only if B and C are both selected and A and D are not.

hints.first_error: 只選擇網頁真正支持的陳述，尤其是「Skills & Qualities」清單。如果某項條件從來沒有出現，即使聽起來合理，也不要選。必須選出全部正確選項，而且不能多選。

feedback.correct: Yes. The skills list says a lifeguard must be a strong and confident swimmer, stay alert, and be able to react quickly.
feedback.incorrect_after_retry: The correct set is B and C only. Line 13 says you need to be a strong and confident swimmer. Lines 14 and 16 say you need to stay alert and be able to react quickly. A is not in the text (the job is at a public swimming pool / leisure centre). D is not stated: good communication and teamwork skills are not the same as being talkative and outgoing.

items.explanation: Multi-select with two unambiguous keys from the skills list. A and D are unsupported. No borderline ‘must’ was included.

items.direction_en: Finish the note below using words from the webpage. Use ONE word for each blank.
items.direction_zh: 利用網頁中的詞語完成下面的便條。每個空格只填一個單詞。
items.note_full: My uncle has been a leisure centre lifeguard for a year. He works at a (1) ________. He blows a (2) ________ if anyone is breaking a safety rule. He doesn’t (3) ________ much money but he loves his job.
items.stem_context: My uncle has been a leisure centre lifeguard for a year. He works at a (1) ________.
items.acceptable_notes: Case-insensitive. Exact word from the webpage. No extra words (e.g. do not accept 'swimming pool' in blank 1, because the instruction is one word and the printed article is already 'a').

hints.first_error: 第 (1) 格前面是 at a，要填工作地點。查看「Income & working hours」一段怎樣稱呼這個地方。每個空格只填一個單詞。

feedback.correct: Yes. The webpage says lifeguards work in a public swimming pool.
feedback.incorrect_after_retry: The word is pool (lines 19–20: In a public swimming pool…). Use one word from the webpage.

items.explanation: One-word gap in a short personal note; the three answers typify workplace (pool), an object from the duties (whistle), and the income verb (earn).

items.direction_en: Finish the note below using words from the webpage. Use ONE word for each blank.
items.direction_zh: 利用網頁中的詞語完成下面的便條。每個空格只填一個單詞。
items.note_full: My uncle has been a leisure centre lifeguard for a year. He works at a (1) ________. He blows a (2) ________ if anyone is breaking a safety rule. He doesn’t (3) ________ much money but he loves his job.
items.stem_context: He blows a (2) ________ if anyone is breaking a safety rule.
items.acceptable_notes: Case-insensitive. Exact word from the webpage. No extra words (e.g. do not accept 'swimming pool' in blank 1, because the instruction is one word and the printed article is already 'a').

hints.first_error: 第 (2) 格在 blows a 後面。查看「Job descriptions」一段，救生員在有人違反安全規則時會怎樣做。

feedback.correct: Yes. Line 8 says the lifeguard blows a whistle.
feedback.incorrect_after_retry: The word is whistle (lines 8–9).

items.explanation: One-word gap in a short personal note; the three answers typify workplace (pool), an object from the duties (whistle), and the income verb (earn).

items.direction_en: Finish the note below using words from the webpage. Use ONE word for each blank.
items.direction_zh: 利用網頁中的詞語完成下面的便條。每個空格只填一個單詞。
items.note_full: My uncle has been a leisure centre lifeguard for a year. He works at a (1) ________. He blows a (2) ________ if anyone is breaking a safety rule. He doesn’t (3) ________ much money but he loves his job.
items.stem_context: He doesn’t (3) ________ much money but he loves his job.
items.acceptable_notes: Case-insensitive. Exact word from the webpage. No extra words (e.g. do not accept 'swimming pool' in blank 1, because the instruction is one word and the printed article is already 'a').

hints.first_error: 第 (3) 格在 doesn’t 後面，需要一個動詞。查看網頁哪一句談到金錢。

feedback.correct: Yes. The income sentence uses the verb earn.
feedback.incorrect_after_retry: The word is earn (line 19: New lifeguards can earn around…).

items.explanation: One-word gap in a short personal note; the three answers typify workplace (pool), an object from the duties (whistle), and the income verb (earn).

stations.title: Set 2 — Harbour Lights Job Fair
stations.title_zh: 第二組：Harbour Lights 招聘會
stations.student_stem_en: I. Ryan is at a job fair with his mother. Read the job advertisements carefully, choose the best answers for Questions 1–5 and complete Question 6.
stations.student_stem_zh: I. Ryan 正與媽媽參加招聘會。請細心閱讀招聘廣告，選出第 1 至 5 題的最合適答案，並完成第 6 題。

items.stem: To work at East Park Sports Centre, you need to be ______.

hints.first_error: 只看 East Park Sports Centre 的廣告。廣告要求你為兒童遊戲想出甚麼？另外，There is no need to… 那一句可以排除一個常見的誤選。

feedback.correct: Yes. The games helper must come up with new ideas for children’s games, so you need to be creative.
feedback.incorrect_after_retry: The answer is D, creative (lines 28–30). C is a trap: the ad says there is no need to carry heavy equipment, so you do not need to be strong. A and B are not mentioned in this advertisement.

items.explanation: Quality required at one workplace, with a ‘no need to…’ line ruling out strong.

items.stem: To be a storytime helper at Harbour Children’s Library, you need to ______.

statements.supported_by: lines 6–7: familiar with what children aged 4 to 8 like
lines 10–11: use imaginative voices and actions

statements.text: have your story ready before the session starts
statements.supported_by: lines 8–9: prepare a short story before the children arrive (storytime starts promptly at 10 a.m.)

hints.first_error: 把 1 至 4 點逐項對照 Harbour Children’s Library 的廣告。不要只看直接出現的詞，也要看那兩句 bullet 是否公平地支持該陳述。然後才選擇組合。

feedback.correct: Yes. All four statements are fairly supported by the storytime advertisement, so the answer is all of the above.
feedback.incorrect_after_retry: The answer is D. 1 is supported by ‘familiar with what children aged 4 to 8 like’. 2 is supported by ‘use imaginative voices and actions’. 3 is stated (‘good at English’). 4 is supported by ‘prepare a short story before the children arrive’ and ‘starts promptly at 10 a.m.’.

items.explanation: Combination item. Every statement in the accepted combination is fairly supported by the new ad. 4 is a fair reading of ‘prepare… before the children arrive’ and the prompt start time, not a guess from outside the text.

items.direction_zh: 選出最合適的答案。作答時請同時查看詞典義項框。
items.stem: Under the advertisement for ‘Weekend Cycling Guide’, what does the word ‘train’ mean?
items.target_context: We will train you in the first two weeks. (line 17)

glossary.definition: a railway engine and carriages that carry people or goods
glossary.example: We took the early train to Sha Tin.

glossary.definition: a long line of people, animals or things moving together
glossary.example: A train of camels crossed the desert.

glossary.definition: to teach a person or animal the skills for a job or activity
glossary.example: The club will train new members every summer.

glossary.definition: to prepare for a sports event by practising
glossary.example: She trains at the pool for two hours a day.

hints.first_error: 先判斷廣告裏的 train 是名詞還是動詞，再看它在句中的意思。We will train you… 是誰對誰做這件事？不要一看到 train 就選「火車」，也不要因為這與運動有關就立刻選「為比賽練習」。

feedback.correct: Yes. In ‘We will train you’, train is a verb meaning to teach someone the skills for the job (sense 3).
feedback.incorrect_after_retry: The answer is C, sense 3. The company will teach the new cycling guide. Sense 1 (a railway train) is the wrong part of speech and the wrong meaning. Sense 2 is also a noun. Sense 4 is a verb, but it means to practise for a sports event yourself, not to teach a new helper the job.

items.explanation: Dictionary item: the correct sense must match both part of speech and meaning in context. Classic traps are the familiar noun (railway) and a same-POS sports meaning that does not fit ‘We will train you’.

items.direction_zh: 選出最合適的答案。只須根據文字作答，不必看圖。
items.stem: Which is a suitable job for Chris?
items.profile_text: Hi, I’m Chris. I love being outdoors and I cycle to the harbour most weekends. I am cheerful and I enjoy showing new routes to my friends.
items.profile_note: A speech-bubble drawing may be used in the layout, but the question is answerable from this text alone.

options.text: Storytime helper at Harbour Children’s Library
Weekend Cycling Guide for Green Wheel Tours
Music class assistant at Melody Studio
Games helper at East Park Sports Centre

hints.first_error: 把 Chris 說的每一點（outdoors、cycle、weekends、cheerful、showing new routes）逐一對照四則廣告，找出最吻合的一份工作。

feedback.correct: Yes. Green Wheel Tours needs someone cheerful who loves the outdoors and can ride a bicycle; the job is on Saturdays and Sundays. Chris already cycles at weekends and enjoys showing new routes.
feedback.incorrect_after_retry: The answer is B. Chris does not mention English, stories, or young children (A), or music or performing (C). D is only a few hours a month on Sundays and is about children’s games, which Chris does not mention. The cycling ad matches the outdoors, cycling, weekends, cheerfulness, and showing routes.

items.explanation: Match a short textual self-introduction to the most suitable advertisement. No picture is required.

items.stem: According to the advertisements, which one of the following is true?

options.text: To be a storytime helper, you need to be between 4 and 8 years old.
To be a games helper, you need to be a sports champion.
To be a cycling guide, you need to be musical.
To be a music class assistant, you need to be brave and patient.

hints.first_error: 留意誰的年齡被提及：是服務對象，還是應徵者？也要找出廣告寫明 There is no need… 的句子，以及完全沒有出現的特質。正確的一項必須兩方面都有根據。

feedback.correct: Yes. The music class assistant must be patient and must not be afraid of standing in front of a small group, so brave and patient is fairly supported.
feedback.incorrect_after_retry: The answer is D (lines 22–25): patient is stated, and ‘not afraid of standing in front of a small group’ fairly supports brave. A confuses the age of the children at storytime (4 to 8) with the applicant. B is the opposite of the games ad, which says there is no need to be a sports champion. C names a quality that the cycling ad never mentions.

items.explanation: Which statement is true? Traps: audience age mixed up with the applicant; a duty / quality the ad says is not needed; a quality not mentioned.

items.original_item_reason: The source Question 6 page was not supplied. This is a new, exam-typical completion task, not a reconstruction of the missing item.
items.direction_en: Ryan wants to apply for one of the jobs. Finish his message using words from the advertisements. Use ONE word for each blank.
items.direction_zh: Ryan 想申請其中一份工作。利用廣告中的詞語完成他的留言。每個空格只填一個單詞。
items.note_full:
Hello,
I would like to apply for the Weekend Cycling (1) ________ job at Green Wheel Tours.
I love the (2) ________ and I can work on Saturdays and (3) ________.
Please (4) ________ me at the address below.
Ryan
items.label_for_site_and_paper: This Question 6 is an original completion item. The source exam told pupils to complete Question 6 on the next page, but that page was not supplied. Do not treat this item as a reconstruction of the missing source question.

blanks.acceptable_notes: Case-insensitive. The title word is Guide.

hints.first_error: 第 (1) 格在 Weekend Cycling 後面，是這份工作名稱的最後一個詞。請回看右上角的廣告標題。

feedback.correct: Yes. The job is Weekend Cycling Guide.
feedback.incorrect_after_retry: The word is Guide (lines 12–13).

blanks.acceptable_notes: Case-insensitive. Do not accept 'outside' or 'nature'; the advertisement says outdoors.

hints.first_error: 第 (2) 格在 I love the 後面。Green Wheel Tours 的廣告要求你 love the ______。

feedback.correct: Yes. The advertisement says you will need to love the outdoors.
feedback.incorrect_after_retry: The word is outdoors (line 15).

blanks.acceptable_notes: The gap follows ‘Saturdays and’, so only the plural Sundays matches the advertisement and the grammar of the sentence. Do not accept Sunday.

hints.first_error: 第 (3) 格在 Saturdays and 後面。廣告說明獲聘後會在哪兩天工作。注意單複數。

feedback.correct: Yes. The job is on Saturdays and Sundays.
feedback.incorrect_after_retry: The word is Sundays (line 16). Sunday does not fit after Saturdays and.

blanks.acceptable_notes: Case-insensitive. Accept the hyphenated form used in the advertisements (e-mail) and the closed form email. Do not accept write, call, telephone, or contact, which are not the verb used in ‘e-mail us’ and do not fit ‘________ me at the address below’ as tightly.

hints.first_error: 第 (4) 格在 Please 後面，是一個動詞。廣告和頁尾怎樣請有興趣的人聯絡他們？後面是 me at the address below，所以這個動詞要配合「地址」。

feedback.correct: Yes. The advertisements and the footer use e-mail as the way to write to them.
feedback.incorrect_after_retry: The word is e-mail (line 14: e-mail us; also line 34). The form email is also accepted. Call / telephone would not fit ‘at the address below’.

items.explanation: Original auto-markable completion (four one-word gaps) using words from the ads and footer. Not a reconstruction of the missing source Q6.
